page.notes: This scan shows no printed text. It is a photograph of the book's board or cover: a grey-green covered board with a black-and-white checkered (chequerboard) border along the left and bottom edges, and a dark background beyond. There are no printed lines, headings, running heads, page numbers, catchwords or signatures on it. The checkerboard band is a colour calibration or scale target placed by the digitiser, not part of the book, so it is not transcribed. Nothing else is printed on the page.
